title: Camera firmware versions MV 7.1.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new stable camera firmware is now available on Fri, 19 Sep 2025

Bug fixes: Resolved an issue that could cause missed motion events on MV84X
Resolved an issue causing minor recording disruption on MV84X after MV7.1 upgrade
General: Improved MV stability and performance due to optimized system processes
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15

Camera firmware versions MV 7.1.1 changelog

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue that could cause missed motion events on MV84X
  • Resolved an issue causing minor recording disruption on MV84X after MV7.1 upgrade

General

  • Improved MV stability and performance due to optimized system processes

Notice

  • When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15
